items.stem: A battery pack is built from 96 cells in series and 2 in parallel (96s2p). If each cell is nominally 3.7 V and 50 Ah, what is the approximate nominal pack voltage?

options.rationale: That is a single cell; series cells add voltage.
This does not reflect 96 series cells.
Series cells add voltage: 96 × 3.7 V ≈ 355 V. Parallel cells increase capacity, not voltage.
This doubles the voltage as if the parallel cells also added voltage, which they do not.

items.explanation: Series cells add voltage: 96 × 3.7 V ≈ 355 V. Parallel cells increase capacity, not voltage.

items.stem: What is the primary purpose of cell balancing in a battery management system?

options.text: To make every cell physically the same size
options.rationale: Balancing addresses charge state, not physical dimensions.

options.text: To equalise the state of charge across cells so pack capacity is not limited by the weakest cell
options.rationale: Balancing brings cells to a similar state of charge so one cell does not prematurely limit charge or discharge.

options.text: To increase the pack's nominal voltage
options.rationale: Balancing does not change nominal voltage.

options.text: To cool the cells during fast charging
options.rationale: Cooling is handled by thermal management, not balancing.

items.explanation: Balancing brings cells to a similar state of charge so one cell does not prematurely limit charge or discharge.

items.stem: A design review examines mitigations for lithium-ion thermal runaway. Select TWO measures that specifically help limit cell-to-cell propagation within a pack.

options.text: Add thermal barriers or insulation between cells
options.rationale: Inter-cell barriers slow heat transfer, limiting propagation to neighbouring cells.

options.text: Provide venting paths that direct hot gases away from adjacent cells
options.rationale: Directed venting reduces the chance that ejected hot gas ignites neighbours.
Higher voltage does not reduce thermal propagation.

options.text: Remove all temperature sensors to simplify wiring
options.rationale: Fewer sensors reduce early detection and worsen safety.

options.text: Charge the pack at the highest possible current at all times
options.rationale: Aggressive charging increases heat generation and runaway risk.

items.explanation: Inter-cell barriers slow heat transfer, limiting propagation to neighbouring cells.
